About Me I was diagnosed 6 months ago, soon after I quickly researched obsessively everything I could in regards to Crohn's. Looking at my future and the options I had. One thing that kept cropping up was the Crohn's MAP Vaccine (shameless plug) and so I read all the research papers, fired off some questions and found it all made sense and was a cause I could definitely get behind. So I did. :)

Quick Bio of the Vaccine The research conducts at King's College London (and elsewhere) has shown >92% of Crohn's sufferers had a MAP infection. MAP is a bacteria causing extremely similar symptoms in cattle (known of Johne's disease.) A treatment method known as anti-map therapy (AMAT) gave remission results in 70% of people, more than any other treatment. With this and other pieces of research (see website for like 40+ research papers) Professor Taylor has created a vaccine to treat (and potentially 'cure') the presence of MAP. Of course this means if MAP is the underlying cause of Crohn's, it could very probably cure Crohn's sufferers.

More recently the UK government released a report stating MAP is found in food produce and is a cause for major concern with it also being linked to primarily Crohn's but also a host of other diseases. Linky

So I'm here to join the little Voat Crohn's community and be a bridge between you guys and the people working on the vaccine, to answer any questions you have and provide support where I can :)
